import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()

        # Main path
        self.main_path = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=32),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),

            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=32, out_channels='mask', kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=64),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size='mask', stride='mask', padding='mask')
        )

        # Branch path
        self.branch_path = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=16, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(num_features=16),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        )

        # Flatten layer
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()

        # Fully connected layers
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=512)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(in_features=512, out_features=10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # the initial shape of x is: (1, 3, 32, 32)
        # Main path output
        main_out = self.main_path(x)  # output tensor shape of this layer should be (1, 64, 8, 8)

        # Branch path output
        branch_out = self.branch_path(x)  # output tensor shape: (1, 16, 16, 16)

        # Combine outputs
        combined_out = torch.add(main_out, branch_out)

        # Flatten
        flattened = self.flatten(combined_out)

        # Fully connected layers
        fc_out = self.fc1(flattened)
        fc_out = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)(fc_out)
        fc_out = self.fc2(fc_out)

        return fc_out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = DL_Model()
    input_tensor = torch.randn(1, 3, 32, 32)  # Batch size of 1, 3 channels, 32x32 image
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)
    print(output_tensor.shape)
